Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "line", "box": [ 0.0768, 0.365, 0.8464, 0.016 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "paper", "box": [ 0.086, 0.1794, 0.217733, 0.1408 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "EARLIER CHAPTERS", "label_box": [ 0.07799999999999999, 0.32620000000000005, 0.23373300000000002, 0.030799999999999945 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.362, 0.1794, 0.217733, 0.1408 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "DATED ADDITION", "label_box": [ 0.354, 0.32620000000000005, 0.23373300000000002, 0.030799999999999945 ] }, { "asset": "paper", "box": [ 0.638, 0.1794, 0.217733, 0.1408 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "4 SEPTEMBER", "label_box": [ 0.63, 0.32620000000000005, 0.23373300000000002, 0.030799999999999945 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "timeline", "source": "
**Frame:** Curt widens the manuscript's page ribbon from [page 105](105.md) by one lane. The provenance tabs stay attached under every thumbnail, and the new pages carry a tab the book has not used before: `DATED ADDITION — 4 SEPTEMBER`.

**Action:** The book gets less complete and one lane wider at the same time.

**Caption:**
> THE BOOK KNOWS LESS THAN IT DID, ABOUT MORE THAN IT DID.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — creator action; the sentence is the project's standing rule for revision, stated on the page.

", "title": "New pages widen the manuscript with dated provenance" } }
